text: [issue by rpghearthbreaker-lab] ### Minecraft Version 1.21.10 ### Mod Loader Forge ### Describe the Issue Updating balm-forge-1.21.10-21.10.6-all.jar to balm-forge-1.21.10-21.10.8-all.jar via the "update all" function caused a complete dependency failure for every single mod that references it. The exact error from crash assistant was that the mod was not installed *at all* rather than being the wrong version, so something in the dependent mods are requesting something that isn't correctly available in the x.8 version. ### Logs I already fixed it by just downgrading. The logs are gone. [comment by BlayTheNinth (member)] The error in Forge and CrashAssistant is misleading/unclear. The mods failed to load because Balm needs Forge 60.0.15 or higher.
